scope: assigned analyzer + re remainder only; no prompt edits

findings.reason: IGNORECASE/MULTILINE/DOTALL map declared flags to universal regex operations; the profile controls which flags each pattern uses.
Analysis/entity/relation JSON field names are the existing public interchange contract, not domain vocabulary.

The old AnalyzerRules::from_json API still defaults missing relation confidence to0.5. Effective profile conversion resolves parameters.relation_confidence before this decoder, so profile execution does not depend on this literal.
Old public entity_type/relation_type string constants remain for source compatibility. Executable extraction never branches on these names; kinds and predicates are arbitrary profile strings.
Legacy aggregate constructors keep1.0/0.5 values. Extractor execution writes resolved profile confidence explicitly; direct caller-created objects are caller data.

Entity rules select capture1 if any group participated, otherwise whole match; relation rules select subject1/object2 and source0 at258-262. These are the existing trusted extraction operation semantics. An alternative capture mapping needs an additive rule-schema capability; not migrated here.
Generic case-insensitive substring hit count and >= comparison; dictionaries and threshold are profile data.
source=regex identifies the actual executor and cannot be spoofed by the profile. Empty summary is absence of generated prose.
Node kinds, switches over syntax/escapes/flags, numeric radices and Unicode predicates implement regex language grammar, not provider/model/domain names.
VM instruction opcodes and capture-slot layout define universal regex operations.

10000000-step default is now defaults.step_limit in re.pack, with validated compile(profile)/with_profile and profile inspection; legacy mutable set_step_limit remains. Per-user-root consumer wiring and x10 preflight need consuming owner integration.
Quantifier decimal accumulation into int has no explicit overflow check. This is numeric parser correctness, not an invented resource threshold or domain policy.

Request branding/header recipe remained in source because thread1 owns full prompt/request composer. Also fixed model fallback/merge uses Runtime builtin analyzer reference; thread1 must consume checked semantic profile instance and its hash.
